The `storage` singleton in `storage.py` initializes\nthe schema on import, so the database is created as soon as the server starts.\n\nTables:\n\n- `users` — registered accounts with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password hashes and salts.\n- `sessions` — combat initiative order, round/turn index, and active conditions.\n- `compendium_monsters` and `compendium_items` — reusable reference entries.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, `campaign_events` — classic campaign state and log.\n- `campaign_quests`, `campaign_factions`, `campaign_npcs` — quest and relationship tracking.\n- `campaign_inventory`, `crafting_projects` — shared inventory and downtime crafting.\n- `campaign_sessions`, `session_attendance` — session scheduling and attendance.\n- `play_campaigns`, `play_campaign_members` — live-play campaign lobby and party.\n- `narrations` — chronological narration, action, and resolution events.\n- `campaign_documents` — durable story text and DM-only notes.\n\n`POST /v1/storage/reset` drops and recreates all tables except `users`, keeping\nauthenticated actors available across the maintenance reset. `GET /v1/storage/status`\nreports the driver, schema version, and initialization flag.\n\n### Request routing\n\n`api.py` keeps three ordered lists of route tuples: `(compiled_pattern, handler)`.\n`Handler.do_GET`, `Handler.do_POST`, and `Handler.do_PUT` iterate the\ncorresponding list and invoke the first handler whose pattern matches the request\npath. Error payloads are intentionally coarse-grained (e.g.\n`{\"error\": \"invalid request\"}`) and match the original behavior.\n\n### Authentication\n\nThe shared helpers `_authenticate` and `_require_auth` read the `Authorization:\nBearer session-<username>` header, look up the user in `storage`, and enforce\nrole requirements (`dm`, `player`, or any known role).
